teaching_contrasts.now: A visitor enters the Vixen research portal and explores authentic cybernetic works without being forced to learn host infrastructure nomenclature.
teaching_contrasts.why: The host platform must sustain the performance without displacing the research object.
teaching_contrasts.exact: Host infrastructure terminology is strictly partitioned from default public navigation; internal engine metrics remain accessible in advanced inspection tools.

teaching_contrasts.now: Exact byte counts, SHA-256 digests, and contribution intervals are fully catalogued while original text bodies remain withheld from the public surface.
teaching_contrasts.why: Catalog completeness must not be confused with unearned public release of sensitive manuscript bodies.
teaching_contrasts.exact: Three-tier capability contract separates Authorized Viewable Text, Catalogue Metadata Only, and Unavailable Original Bodies; missing bodies are never fabricated.

teaching_contrasts.now: Synthesis bench demonstrates candidate control-plane mappings under explicit illustrative preset labels.
teaching_contrasts.why: Exploratory UI controls must not be misconstrued as live automated peer review or scientific admission.
teaching_contrasts.exact: Presets are explicitly marked ILLUSTRATIVE_PRESET_DEMO with empirical_credit = 0; actual scientific promotion authority remains false.

teaching_contrasts.now: Captured snapshot entries retain recorded predecessor state upon subsequent source withdrawal within the active browser session.
teaching_contrasts.why: Demonstrating non-retroactivity in-session must not fabricate claims of durable cross-session database persistence.
teaching_contrasts.exact: Snapshot entries are frozen in-memory via Object.freeze under scope SESSION_LOCAL_SNAPSHOT; page refresh cleanly clears the session array.

teaching_contrasts.now: Eight dual-manifestation cases initialize at UNADJUDICATED_PAIR, allowing researchers to explore hypothetical splits without being forced to decide identity.
teaching_contrasts.why: Scholarly exploration must preserve ambiguity and negative space until authorized human closure occurs.
teaching_contrasts.exact: Default state remains UNADJUDICATED_PAIR with [32, 40] partition recalculation; visitors may freely explore and exit without penalty.
